title: SciToT: Multimodal Tip-of-the-Tongue Retrieval for Scientific Papers
abstract: arXiv:2611.05829v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Researchers frequently encounter difficulties re-finding scientific papers when they remember aspects of the content but cannot recall reliable identifiers, such as titles or author names. This type of re-finding task, known as tip-of-the-tongue (ToT) retrieval, is particularly challenging for scientific documents, where recollections may involve textual information and visual elements, including figures, diagrams, and plots. Existing ToT retrieval benchmarks do not address scientific search.   We introduce a multimodal benchmark for scientific ToT retrieval, comprising 108,512 open-access scientific documents across five domains and 11,499 synthetically generated queries. To construct the benchmark, we propose a scalable query elicitation pipeline that independently extracts textual and visual memory cues from source documents and uses large language models to generate queries resembling incomplete human recollections. translated_title: SciToT：面向科学论文的多模态“话到嘴边”（Tip-of-the-Tongue）检索
translated_abstract: 研究人员经常难以重新找到某篇科学论文，尽管他们记得论文内容的某些方面，却无法回忆起可靠的标识信息，例如标题或作者姓名。这类重新查找任务被称为“话到嘴边”检索，对于科学文献而言尤为困难，因为人们对科学文献的记忆可能同时涉及文本信息和视觉元素，包括插图、示意图和绘图。然而，现有的ToT检索基准并未涵盖科学搜索场景。我们提出了一个面向科学ToT检索的多模态基准，包含涵盖五个领域的108,512篇开放获取科学文献以及11,499条合成生成的查询。为构建该基准，我们设计了一个可扩展的查询引导流水线，该流水线从源文档中独立提取文本记忆线索和视觉记忆线索，并利用大语言模型生成类似于人类不完整记忆的查询。我们对……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个面向科学论文的多模态“话到嘴边”（ToT）检索基准SciToT，通过从文本和视觉元素中提取记忆线索并用大语言模型合成模拟人类不完整记忆的查询，填补了科学文献重新查找任务中缺乏评测基准的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SciToT, the first multimodal benchmark for scientific tip-of-the-tongue retrieval, comprising 108,512 open-access papers across five domains and 11,499 synthetic queries generated via a scalable pipeline that extracts both textual and visual memory cues to simulate incomplete human recollections.
